name: marekkirejczyk-skills
description: Marek Kirejczyk's agent skills. explain-with-slides: a slide deck walking through any repository or pull request, with screenshots from the running code. explain-with-video: the same walkthrough as a narrated video with captions. refactor-tests: brings a file, class or branch's tests up to written rules for each test type, and covers every case. self-documented-code: renames everything in a scope so each name explains itself and each concept has one name.
